title: Escape: Evasion, Immortality & Metastasis
description: To survive, an anomaly must escape everything built to remove it: hide its markers from the immune system, switch telomerase back on and forget how to age, grow its own blood vessels, and finally leave - slip into the blood and seed itself somewhere new. Unlocks the Immortal Cell Line and the Metastatic Spore.

puzzle.goal: A tumour of N cells grows fast while it is small and slows as it outgrows its blood supply: its specific growth rate decays exponentially in time at a rate α, so that it levels off at a carrying capacity K. Starting from N₀ cells, write the number of cells at time t.
puzzle.name: Gompertz law of tumour growth
puzzle.form: K * exp ( ln ( N _ 0 / K ) * exp ( - α * t ) )
puzzle.expr: K * exp ( ln ( n / K ) * exp ( - α * t ) )
puzzle.ask: With K and the starting size n in units of 10⁹ cells, α per month and t in months, find the size of the tumour.

vars.\u03b1: decay rate of the growth rate

puzzle.method: Write d ln N/dt = r e^{−αt} and integrate; or note that d ln N/dt = α ln(K/N), so ln(N/K) itself decays exponentially.
